summary: Retrieves system/thread locale information as an ANSI or multibyte string, abstracting the wide-vs-ANSI Win32 locale APIs. Caches the detected system mode in the global dword_8D4204 (0 = undetected, 1 = GetLocaleInfoW available, 2 = ANSI only) on first use. Mode 2 returns the direct GetLocaleInfoA result. Mode 1 probes the wide buffer size, allocates a stack buffer via alloca (with __alloca_probe), fills it with GetLocaleInfoW and converts the result to the caller's code page with WideCharToMultiByte, falling back to the global CodePage (0x008D3F48) when the caller passes 0. Returns 0 on any probe/fill failure.

local_names.Locale: LCID whose locale info is requested
local_names.LCType: LCTYPE constant selecting the requested locale info
local_names.lpLCData: output buffer for the ANSI string
local_names.cchData: capacity of lpLCData in chars (0 = size query)
local_names.CodePage: target code page for WideCharToMultiByte (0 defaults to global CodePage)
local_names.v11: stack-allocated WCHAR buffer for the wide locale string
local_names.v13: wide buffer length in WCHARs returned by the size probe

operations.description: Read cached locale mode dword_8D4204; if zero (undetected) fall through to probe which Win32 locale API the system supports.
GetLocaleInfoW(0, 1u, 0, 0): wide-API availability probe; success sets the detected mode to 1.
GetLocaleInfoA(0, 1u, 0, 0): ANSI-API fallback probe; when both probes fail the function returns 0, otherwise the detected mode is set to 2.
Cache the detected system locale mode (1 = wide, 2 = ANSI) in the global dword_8D4204.
When the cached mode is 2 (ANSI only), forward the request to GetLocaleInfoA(Locale, LCType, lpLCData, cchData) and return its result directly.
When the cached mode is neither 1 nor 2, return 0.
When the caller passes CodePage == 0, default it to the global CodePage (0x008D3F48).
GetLocaleInfoW(Locale, LCType, 0, 0): size probe for the wide string; on failure the function returns 0.
Allocate the wide buffer on the stack: byte size = 2 * wide_char_count + 3, with the low 2 bits cleared (v8 & 0xFC), via alloca guarded by __alloca_probe.
GetLocaleInfoW(Locale, LCType, buffer, size): fill the stack WCHAR buffer; on failure the function returns 0.

WideCharToMultiByte(CodePage, 0x220, buffer, -1, lpLCData, cchData, 0, 0): convert the wide locale string to the target code page; when cchData is 0 the null output buffer is used as a pure size query.
Return the WideCharToMultiByte result (characters written or required buffer size); the ANSI direct path returns the GetLocaleInfoA result instead.
